Is your silicone sealant letting you down?

Mouldy, discoloured, or cracked silicone sealant isn't just unsightly - its a gateway to water damage that can cost you thousands in repairs!

London Reseal arranges specialist silicone sealant and mastic services for domestic and commercial clients across London. We connect you with a vetted local expert — so you don't have to search, vet, or chase anyone.
Signs you need London Reseal:

Black mould growing along bath or shower edges

Water seeping behind sealant

Cracked, peeling or discoloured seals

Sealant that has yellowed with age

Gaps forming around kitchen worktops

Don't wait until a small problem becomes expensive water damage.

Why London Reseal?

Industry Leading Guarantee: we're so confident in our work that we offer a full workmanship guarantee on every job. No one else matches this - because no one else matches our quality standards.

Premium Products Only: Our specialists don't cut corners with cheap sealant. Every job uses professional grade silicone — designed for longevity, mould resistance, and a flawless finish.

Vetted & Trustworthy Specialists: We only work with tradespeople who have been personally checked. Proper removal, meticulous preparation, expert application — every time. No cowboys, no shortcuts.
